input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 6 (Termination)
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision because the Agreement is silent on what happens to our data and work in progress at termination: Contractor gives us up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. We can accept a 90-day assistance period as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days, return to Company all Works, Confidential Information and other data and materials of Company in Contractor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and materials from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
